hints.title: Diagonal Invariant
hints.text: All cells (r, c) on the same top-left to bottom-right diagonal share the identical invariant difference r - c.

hints.title: Group by Diagonal Key
hints.text: Collect elements belonging to the same r - c key into a list or min-heap.

hints.title: Sort and Re-assign
hints.text: Sort the collected values for each diagonal and write them back into the matrix in increasing row order.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting without grouping by r - c mixes cells across unrelated diagonals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table keyed by diagonal index r - c groups elements cleanly, sorting each diagonal of length at most min(M, N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses the key property r - c to group diagonals directly.
complexity.notes: Pop from reverse sorted lists allows O(1) in-place reassignment.

solutions.approach: diagonal grouping by r - c and pop reassignment
